costco_FY2024.note: Calls net income (+17.1%) and operating income (+14.4%) the 'largest revenue and income contributors'; the sheet gives no such contribution measure, they are just two line items that grew.

costco_FY2026.note: Figures correct. 'Strong financial performance ... investment in growth' is interpretation.

lacity_bva_FY2025.note: Unappropriated Balance is given as 'utilisation 100.0%' (that is the unspent share; utilisation is 0.0%). General City Purposes 'utilisation 44.6%' is also the unspent share (utilisation is 55.4%). So the 'lowest utilisation' sentence states the opposite of the data.

lacity_bva_FY2026.note: 'Lowest budget utilisation ... with figures of $397.9m, $263.5m, $89.1m' are the revised budgets of General Services, General City Purposes and Mayor, not utilisation (71.6%, 71.8%, 76.6%).

lacity_gf_2025-10.note: 'This increase is attributed to ... Capital Finance Administration (+$64.3m) and the Fire department, which experienced a decrease of $21.4m.' Fire fell, so it cannot be a source of the increase.

lacity_gf_2025-12.note: 'This increase was driven by Non-Departmental - General (+$115.6m) and Fire, which decreased by $9.9m.' Same problem: a decreasing item named as a driver of the increase.

lacity_gf_2026-01.note: Figures correct. 'These figures highlight significant growth in the city's financial operations' is interpretation, and the total only moved +1.6%.

lacity_gf_2026-02.note: 'The decrease is attributed to Human Resources Benefits, which increased by $13.6m ...' The first driver rose, so it did not cause the decrease.

lacity_gf_2026-03.note: Total, five movers and amounts match.

lacity_gf_2026-04.note: Liability Claims is given a 7.4% decrease; 7.4% is Non-Departmental General's change, Liability Claims fell 50.3% (the $12.8m is right).

sama_pos_2021Q3.note: Figures correct. 'Robust performance of the Restaurants & Café sector' is interpretation (borderline).

sama_pos_2022Q1.note: Electronic & Electric Devices is given an 'average weekly value of SAR 305 million'; that is the Q1 2021 value, the Q1 2022 value is SAR 268 million. Also 'reflecting a strong performance' (interpretation).

sama_pos_2022Q3.note: 'The Other category, which includes miscellaneous goods and services' - the sheet lists them as two separate categories (Other +31.2%, Miscellaneous +38.0%); the figures themselves are right.

sama_pos_2022Q4.note: Figures correct. 'Indicate a strong performance in the retail sector' is interpretation.

sama_pos_2024Q3.note: Says the Other category's SAR 221m rise contributed to 'a total increase of 213 million SAR'; 213 is Electronic & Electric Devices' current value. Also 'improvement in the spending habits of consumers' (interpretation).

sama_pos_2025Q1.note: 'Other and miscellaneous goods and services ... +20.6%, from SAR 2,056m to SAR 2,480m' - those are Other's figures alone; Miscellaneous Goods and Services rose 9.7%.

sama_pos_2025Q2.note: 'Reached a total of SAR 12.88 billion' - 12.88bn is the average weekly POS value, not a total for the quarter (borderline: the rest of the draft is correct).

costco_FY2024.note: Net income and operating income changes are swapped: net income rose $1.07bn and operating income $1.17bn, the draft says the reverse.

costco_FY2026.note: '$27.9bn, which is a 8.9% increase in operating cash flow from $13.34bn to $15.82bn' - 8.9% is SG&A growth (cash flow grew 18.6%) and $27.9bn is the revenue change. Capex growth is given as 18.6%, which is the cash-flow figure (capex +17.0%).

lacity_gf_2026-03.note: Water and Electricity 'decreased by $4.1m'; the sheet says $4.2m (4.1 is Petroleum Products).

sama_pos_2021Q3.note: Says Miscellaneous Goods and Services had 'a decrease of 4 million SAR' and that the 'increase ... is modest'; it rose SAR 303m, the -SAR 4m belongs to Electronics. Also 'growing steadily over the past year' (no support).

sama_pos_2022Q1.note: 'Other and Miscellaneous Goods and Services experienced an increase of SAR 357m' (357 is Other only); 44.0% is given for Other and 30.9% for Miscellaneous, which are swapped.

sama_pos_2023Q4.note: Beverage and Food and Restaurants & Café 'saw their values increase by 1.07 billion SAR' - that is the total weekly change; Miscellaneous is given 14.1% in one sentence (that is Beverage and Food) and 15.3% in the next.

sama_pos_2024Q4.note: 'Gas Stations (up) ... experienced decreases' and 'Gas Stations (up) and Public Utilities (down) remained unchanged' - Gas Stations rose SAR 127m, Public Utilities fell SAR 67m.
